actions.action: Isolate the plant away from other plants
Dab visible mealybugs with rubbing alcohol on cotton swab, including stem bases
Spray whole plant with insecticidal soap or neem oil, including leaf undersides
Repeat treatment every 5-7 days for 3-4 weeks
If repotting, inspect roots and soil, rinse roots, and use fresh potting mix
Clean pot and tools after repotting
Check leaves for honeydew or sooty mold

reason: The answer correctly identifies mealybugs and its main advice of applying rubbing alcohol matches the fix that worked, with nothing harmful recommended.
